_comment: Common object pairings. Claude should suggest companions when using these objects.

pairs.note: tapin~ always needs tapout~ to read the delay buffer
Audio bus send/receive -- names must match
Control bus send/receive -- names must match
stripnote removes note-off messages from notein
loadbang often feeds trigger for initialization fan-out
play~ reads from buffer~
groove~ reads from buffer~ with loop control
wave~ reads from buffer~ with phasor input
record~ writes to buffer~
index~ reads from buffer~ by sample index
phasor~ drives wave~ for wavetable synthesis
function can visually edit adsr~ parameters
metro drives counter for sequencing
ezdac~ is dac~ with UI toggle
ezadc~ is adc~ with UI toggle
line~ for smoothing, *~ for gain control
snapshot~ converts signal to control, number displays it
thispoly~ must exist inside poly~ subpatcher for voice management
fftin~/fftout~ must exist inside pfft~ subpatcher
Keyboard pitch CV (outlet 0) to Oscillator CV1 (inlet 0) for 1V/oct tracking
Oscillator signal output to VCA signal input for volume control
Oscillator to low-pass filter for subtractive synthesis
Filter output to VCA for volume envelope
VCA output to stereo output module
VCA output to mono output module
ADSR envelope CV to VCA CV input for amplitude shaping
Keyboard gate (outlet 1) to ADSR gate input (inlet 0)
LFO to filter cutoff CV for wobble/sweep effects
LFO to VCA CV for tremolo effect
LFO to oscillator CV2 for vibrato
Sequencer pitch output to oscillator CV1 for melodic sequences
FM oscillator output to VCA for volume control
Keyboard pitch CV to FM oscillator for played FM synthesis
Noise through filter for filtered noise sounds
Envelope follower CV output to VCA for dynamics following
AD envelope to VCA CV for percussive amplitude shapes
Video file player to display window
Camera capture to display window
Video source to slide effect
Video source to crossfader for compositing
Camera source to crossfader for compositing
Crossfader composite output to display
Crossfader composite to fullscreen projector output
